target_customer: Real estate syndicators and general partners who raise money from investors
problem: Syndicators manually prepare documents, wire instructions and investor reports. The platform handles capital raising, investor portal and fund administration.

founders.name: Perry Zheng
founders.background_notes: Also an active real estate syndicator (reports 1,500 plus units and 16M USD raised in the April 2021 company post). Education not found.

competitors.name: Juniper Square
competitors.what: Investment management and investor portal software for real estate sponsors

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly workflow software: e-signature, investor onboarding, wire instructions, distributions and reporting; fund accounting adds some depth.

defensibility.rationale: Investor data and ongoing deal history lock in sponsors somewhat, but multiple rival portals existed before the batch.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals continued to operate; no acquisition of Cash Flow Portal found by 2026.

market_need_then: Syndicators raised money with spreadsheets and e-signatures; the YC page reports 300 syndicators and 3,000 investors five months after launch, and a 2021 GeekWire item covered the company's early growth.

identity.voice_and_tone: Founder-operator voice: written as a practitioner who syndicates himself

branding.community_and_virality: Heavy podcast and blog content marketing in the real estate investing community.

brand_strength.rationale: The descriptive name is clear to the niche but generic; the founder's own syndicator credibility seems to matter more than the brand.

outcome_analysis: A Lyft engineering manager who was himself a syndicator built investor management software for peers, launched in 2021, claimed 6-figure ARR five months later and joined YC in Winter 2022. By 2025 the site lists roughly 6B USD of customer AUM and the company reportedly has about 26 staff. Outside funding is not verified, so growth looks founder-funded and capital-efficient.
notes: Aggregators list a 3.5M USD seed from YC and Goodwater Capital (Employbl) and a 3.76M USD round in November 2021 (Extruct); a GeekWire item also cites a 3.5M USD raise. These are single-source or conflicting, so unverified and not recorded as rounds. Company blog says SyndicationPro-like naming is not confirmed; a directory says the company was formerly SyndicationPro but this is unverified. Headcount of 26 comes from Employbl.
